June 12, 2018 - By Hugh Holland
Prescott General Partners Llc decreased its stake in Nu Skin Enterprises Inc (NUS) by 3.18% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Prescott General Partners Llc sold 43,281 shares as the company’s stock rose 10.65% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund held 1.32 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $97.07 million, down from 1.36 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Prescott General Partners Llc who had been investing in Nu Skin Enterprises Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $4.52B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.20% or $0.99 during the last trading session, reaching $81.18. About 434,715 shares traded. Nu Skin Enterprises, Inc. (NYSE:NUS) has risen 45.84% since June 12, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.27% the S&P500.
